description: This Java class 'ApiRequestContextHolder' provides thread-local storage for API request context information within a web service. It offers methods to retrieve, create, and clear the context associated with each thread.

classes.name: ApiRequestContextHolder
classes.description: A utility class for managing API request context data in a thread-local manner.

methods.name: clearContext
methods.description: Removes the current thread's API request context.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's API request context, creating a new one if it does not exist.
